Method of Attack: Bypassing Windows AppLocker by creating and registering custom control panel items (CPL files) that are modified DLLs to launch cmd.exe or other utilities to execute malicious commands
Modifying registry key HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Control Panel\CPLs to add rogue CPL items
Proxy-like technique using control.exe to run malicious CPL files that start blocked utilities like cmd.exe or PowerShell
Attack Vector: Registry key modification to add rogue CPL files
Abuse of Microsoft-signed binaries (control.exe, reg, regedit) allowed by default AppLocker rules
